description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』より３０ＭＭ 1/144 eEXM-S04A フォレスティエリ 04が登場。
description.en: 30MM 1/144 eEXM-S04A Forestieri 04 is now available from "30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN".

description.ja: 特務仕様の頭部パーツやアーマー各種、リペルライフル、レジストシールドが新規で付属し、専用カラーリングを採用。
description.en: Special head parts, various armors, repel rifles, and resist seals are newly included, and special coloring is used.

description.en: Furthermore, various customization parts are included. An all-in-one set packed with the charm of "30 MINUTES MISSIONS".

description.ja: デザイナー海老川兼武氏監修の機体を立体化。
description.en: Three-dimensional version of the aircraft supervised by designer Kanetake Ebikawa.

description.ja: 強化された本機には頭部・胸部・肩部・脚部、リペルライフル、レジストシールドが新規で同梱。
description.en: This strengthened machine comes with a new head, chest, shoulders, legs, repel rifle, and resist seal.

description.ja: レジストシールドは肩部、腕部に装着可能。
description.en: Resist Seal can be attached to the shoulders and arms.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included.

description.ja: 本機体の専用マーキングや、ライン等を収録した、新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: A newly designed water transfer decal containing special markings and lines for this unit is included.

description.ja: ●　専用カラーリングで特務仕様を商品化
description.en: ● Commercialization of special specifications with exclusive coloring

description.ja: 本体及びオプションパーツの成形色は、専用カラーリングを採用。
description.en: The molding color of the main body and optional parts uses a special coloring.

description.ja: 特務仕様の特殊な機体色を表現。
description.en: Expressing the special aircraft color of the special mission specification.

description.ja: 支援メカ「ロイロイ」が専用カラーリングで付属。
description.en: A support mecha "Roi-Roi" is included with a special coloring.

description.ja: オプションパーツを取り付けてカスタマイズすることも可能。
description.en: It is also possible to customize by attaching optional parts.

description.ja: ●　自分専用にカスタマイズ可能！豊富なカスタマイズ用パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Customizable for your own use! Comes with a wide variety of customization parts.

description.ja: 本体を構成するパーツの他、カスタマイズ用パーツも付属。
